decision.finding: Exact runner.py builds three JSON payloads, writes latest/audit/anata separately, but run_once returns only output and anata_output; frame_audit is NOT returned. Therefore a reader-coherence regression must capture the actual audit_latest.json payload at the atomic_write_json call site, not infer B's expected audit from return values or equal as_of_ms. Also distinguish single-writer/interleaved-reader coherence from the independent two-writer B-final serialization contract; a writer-only lock cannot prove readers see a coherent triplet.

At fixed T=1800000060000, run A completely with network=False and valid local external_jsonl A. Record persisted A latest/audit/anata payloads.

Run B on the same local_dir and T with a distinct valid local external_jsonl B. Monkeypatch runner.atomic_write_json: call original, deepcopy each successfully written payload keyed by writer and filename; after B latest.json replacement, set event and wait on release_B in a finally-safe gated section.

While B is paused, read the three persisted JSONs as one reader observation. Always release_B in finally; join with bounded timeouts; require both run_once calls returned, no exceptions, no source_errors, B fixture appended exactly once.

Require each A-versus-B captured output payload differs (latest, audit, anata); fail fixture preflight if not. Compare reader triplet to full captured A or B triplet using canonical JSON SHA256, not timestamp. Mixed B-latest/A-audit/A-anata is RED, not accepted as coherent.

After release, require persisted final triplet equals B's captured payload triplet. Preserve fixture and overlay SHA256, writer/reader payload hashes, event ordering, exit codes, stdout/stderr and non-skipped counts.

Separate corrected two-writer contract test_runner_output_generation.py must require both writer returns and final B timestamp, not merely three equal stamps; threaded results are not cross-process proof.
Run python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_same_clock_reader.py part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_output_generation.py; then python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests.
